title: Terrible
label: Solid City (per Reynolds)

type.basis: Produced by Wiley; Reynolds (2005) pairs it with Know We as garage rap in his Grime Primer. Release year is uncertain.

sound.text: Reynolds (Wire Grime Primer, 2005) pairs it with 'Know We' as 'chip-off-the-same-block': simple programmed beats, MC-carried, with a Puff Daddy soundbite.

context.text: Record shops treated it as the follow-up to 'Know We', but Wiley did not want it released under the Pay As U Go name; Flowdan suggested 'Roll Deep', after a phrase popular in bashment songs, so this record is the origin of the Roll Deep name.
Wikipedia's Pay As U Go article says it was recorded in 2001.
RBMA (2015): Wiley signed 'Terrible' to Teebone with 'Know We' and 'Wickedest Ting' for a reported £300.

calls.label: garage rap, listed in a Grime Primer
